claim: LDI's DE carries out of column 255 into the next row, so copying a tile at the right edge of Layer 2 needs its last byte by hand, or DE pushed and popped per row.

evidence.text: LDI's DE carries out of column 255 into the next row; a tile at the right edge needs its last byte by hand; the whole-picture replay model caught it where hook registers and RAM did not.
Copying a tile at column 31 carried into D; push and pop DE per row rather than trusting E to wrap.
